The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `memo_service_webhooks.go`. It calls `webhook.PostAsync` from `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`.

The signing mechanism still needs to be identified.

message.text:
The dispatcher is `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, called from `CreateMemo` in `memo_service.go`. The delivery package and signing mechanism remain to be identified.

The delivery package is `internal/webhook`. The signing mechanism is Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256. The final answer is:

DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256

q22.
DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go; internal/webhook; Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256

`CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, which loads the creator's hooks and posts via `webhook.PostAsync`. `internal/webhook/webhook.go` delivers the HTTP request and, when a secret is set, signs the body with HMAC-SHA256 using Standard Webhooks headers (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature: v1,...`).
